description:
Give `Priority` its rank order through `Ord`, and delete the copied rank matches.

## Background

`Priority` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:177`) has no `Ord`, so `commands/query.rs:141-146` and `commands/issue.rs:788-793` each copy a priority-to-rank match to sort critical first. Both sorts rely on stability to keep tie order (`commands/issue.rs:785`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Priority` implements `Ord` with low below normal below high below critical.
- [hard] REQ-02: Both rank matches are gone, and both sorts order critical first with tie order unchanged.
title: Priority orders by rank through Ord
